From entering the NBA straight out of high school in 1995 to becoming an MVP in Minnesota and an NBA champion in Boston, Garnett gave everything he had to the game. There’s something interesting about that contrast. Sometimes the people who appear the toughest are the ones who have learned to keep the most to themselves.
